description:
The ruthless yet gentle ruler Heart,
the serial killer Mad Hatter, the split-personality gang boss Twins… …
All of this
began before the arrival of 'Alice,' when a woman stepped into the reverse harem novel 'Wonderland'.

Wonderland, a city of criminals and trash.
There, she is the White Rabbit, a messenger and maintainer of order.
What drives this dimension-traveler is the hope that
if she helps the protagonist Alice bring the story to a close,
she might be able to return to her family.
However, even after Alice's arrival,
the men who should have been hers
fail to fulfill their roles, merely hovering around Soyoon, and
their obsession and blind devotion only intensify.
